notes.title: New building!
notes.content:
[h1]Tavern[/h1]

A new building has been added.
In this tavern mainly alcoholic drinks will gradually be available in the form of items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/c8578fa5bd2b41444573c1b9776c88938cf43d33.png[/img]

tags.feature: A new building has been added.

notes.title: Racetrack!
notes.content:
[h1]Desert racing track[/h1]

Race a time trial with an amphibious vehicle or monster truck on the desert race track. Later it will also be possible to drive other vehicles on the racetrack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/3994a6888a0b57b134ff9ea2f2b00d99de78771f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/7e842d1915a2d0560844bfd9d4fb2478e4738ccf.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/28fcffb8976f36aa63afa2b169bc49216dc534bf.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Yacht[/h1]

A yacht has been added and is for sale in the yacht shop. As with all boats, the yacht can also be bought, rented, sold or used as an investment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/7e970344d3dcd1ea966898b872cea641a4720c4d.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/0f3f7a2a0536c9c239bd2c5055a11e6b55c73ea6.png[/img]

tags.feature: Race a time trial with an amphibious vehicle or monster truck on the desert race track.
A yacht has been added and is for sale in the yacht shop.

notes.title: Speedboats!
notes.content:
[h1]Speedboat[/h1]

Take a speedboat along the coast to coral reefs for diving or use them as an investment. The selling price for boats changes daily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/1647369b24b68c47be0ff8108d9c59162fac151f.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Swimming animation[/h1]

The swimming animations have been revised.
It is now also possible to buy flippers to move faster both above and below the water.

notes.title: Relaxation and jet skis!
notes.content:
[h1]Jetski[/h1]

Jet ski to small side islands or cruise along the coast to coral reefs for scuba diving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/add99a8de43a2c09d59fa838e4d349b93ae0222a.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/d1e9c3c8ba95b7ab50ca961aa0980389b5dc9065.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Relaxation[/h1]

Take an air mattress in your inventory, place it where you like it and relax, tan or just skip a bit of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/b4f3211302366f80e622fab6a889bed14ec39eca.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Island expansion and sharks
notes.content:
[h1]Sharks[/h1]

[b]Be careful when swimming and diving in the sea![/b]
Sharks can now swim near the coast.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/726d68aaa4c60238a4c1aeee265672fe75af50c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/7943042de637c0b9a6e803d0e4f42f6d9789ad1b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/801eac496872394069d9bc4176240246bc1626d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/8f29bc794233591631a295351a83c5617537ec14.png[/img][/url]


[hr][/hr]
[h1]Island expansion[/h1]

[b]The island has been expanded a little in the northeast![/b]
Two additional time trials are available on the extended part of the island.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/9a82a33bb8424d8370d8e893e8ae733f7961d91f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/b4217653f180e55d2513b74c5e30ac0e4ce9b5cb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/9a020c0c5b03200db13c6d70d6b9c24531074691.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39040482/d45ad180c3b9ca09af56f45907042595c0fdd086.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Time-Race
notes.content:
[h1]Race on Callparin Island![/h1]

Callparin 2 now also offers the option of completing any time race on the island. For every time race there is a specification with which vehicles can be used in this race. There are currently five time races to choose from, but more will follow.
